Overview

Bergamo is a city in Lombardy with a population of 122,000. A stunning Lombard city with a medieval upper town, Venetian walls, and breathtaking views of the Alps from its hilltop fortress. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
